verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email client/SaaS product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Superhuman Mail. All the evidence describes a hosted client layered on Gmail and Outlook, and a user rebuilding their own app is a workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
